pain_points.statement: Finance is three weeks behind on invoicing due to mismatched data across systems.
pain_points.source_excerpt: finance is 3 weeks behind on invoicing because the data never lines up

desired_state.statement: The client prefers a fixed-fee structure with milestone payments rather than time and materials.
desired_state.source_excerpt: Strong preference for fixed-fee with milestone payments over T&M.

success_criteria.statement: Days-sales-outstanding (DSO) should drop to the industry standard of about five days.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: days-sales-outstanding, which should drop from where we are now back to industry standard

risks_unknowns.statement: The CFO is skeptical of consulting engagements due to past bad experiences.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: Skeptical of consulting engagements; got burned by a previous vendor in 2023.

pain_points.statement: The driver mobile app lacks essential features like photo uploads and messaging.
pain_points.source_excerpt: They can't take photos, they can't flag issues, they can't message the dispatcher.

pain_points.statement: Dispatchers must manually integrate data across three separate systems for a single assignment.
pain_points.source_excerpt: it's three systems for one assignment, and the dispatcher is the integration layer.

desired_state.statement: The company wants to incrementally improve the existing dispatch tool rather than rebuilding it from scratch.
desired_state.source_excerpt: make the case for incremental change instead of a full rebuild.
desired_state.contradiction_note: Sarah (VP Ops) wants incremental change, but Marcus (CTO) has been pushing for a full rebuild for a year.

success_criteria.statement: The solution should avoid creating additional compliance work for the ELD mandate.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: avoid creating new compliance work for him, that's a quiet point in your favor.

risks_unknowns.statement: There is an upcoming federal ELD compliance deadline in November with unclear details.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: ELD compliance deadline in November (federal mandate update; details unclear

pain_points.statement: Dispatchers spend hours on the phone because the driver app is inadequate.
pain_points.source_excerpt: spend two to three hours a day on the phone with drivers

pain_points.statement: Finance staff must manually reconcile mismatched data for every invoice.
pain_points.source_excerpt: finance is doing detective work on every single invoice.

desired_state.statement: The primary operational goal is to fix the invoicing reconciliation process first.
desired_state.source_excerpt: invoicing is the bleeding wound. We need to fix that first.

success_criteria.statement: Dispatch time per load needs to be reduced from twelve minutes to eight minutes.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: If we can get that to eight minutes

risks_unknowns.statement: Tech integration from recent acquisitions remains incomplete.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: Tech integration from those acquisitions is incomplete.

pain_points.statement: There is internal conflict regarding whether to rebuild or incrementally improve the dispatch tool.
pain_points.source_excerpt: that's a fight I've been having internally

desired_state.statement: The VP of Operations wants to start at the lower end of the budget to prove value.
desired_state.source_excerpt: I'd rather come in at the lower end and earn the next phase

success_criteria.statement: A measurable pilot must be in production by the end of Q3 to secure funding.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: have something measurable in production by end of September.

risks_unknowns.statement: The engagement is competitive, with the client evaluating two other firms.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: This is a competitive engagement — they are also talking to two other firms.

risks_unknowns.statement: If a measurable pilot isn't live by Q3, the CFO will pull the project funding.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: Otherwise the funding gets pulled into other projects.
